title: Chapter 540
text:
There was a sea of people in the sanctuary square. Countless players surrounded Ames, and those who were far away even craned their necks to look inside. They all had different expressions: excitement, excitement, curiosity, lust, and so on.

After watching Pork Bun's Black Star series, most Blue Star players recognized the Dragon Emperor. Her popularity among the players was second only to Black Star, not only because Ames was beautiful and sexy, but also because she had a pair of long legs that countless men wanted to lick. The players had seen many beautiful female characters, but more importantly, Ames had the aura of a strong person. She was like an emperor, and her status was respected. She was the strongest person that millions of players had ever seen.

The huge difference in status caused her popularity to remain high. There were even fans who spontaneously formed 'Dragon Emperor's Long Legs Licker Club' on the forums. There was no one else who called themselves licker buddies.

However, when it came to the name of the fan club, Han Xiao's' Black Star's Little Mercenaries' and 'Captain Love Me Again Fan Club' were not much better.

The players could only see Ames in videos, but this time, Ames had appeared in person without any warning. Instantly, it caused a tsunami-like commotion in the sanctuary. Countless players called their friends and brought their families to see her in person.

Although they really wanted to lick her long, jade-like legs, the players took the initiative to maintain a certain distance from her. Ignoring the fact that they did not have the ability to 'take off their pants' or 'lick their NP', just the fact that Ames casually flattened a circle of players who purposely got close to her made the others tactfully back off. They did not want to die and lose EXP.

What a joke, this was someone who could blow up a star! What if she did not control it well and blew up the novice village!

Ames curiously looked at the endless number of players. These were the Space Wonders that Black Star had mentioned. They all seemed to know her and were extremely passionate. She felt that these Inhumans were visiting animals.

She used her ability to scan the Inhumans, but there was nothing special about their body structure. However, the few Inhumans that she had slapped to death had turned into white light and disappeared, leaving no corpse behind. Her force field was enough to distinguish the differences between millions of Inhumans. In less than ten seconds, the Inhumans that she had slapped to death had reappeared in her sensing range. They had indeed revived.

If these people were immortal, even if they were a little weak, they could still be considered a useful force.

This thought flashed through Ames's mind, but she immediately threw it to the back of her mind. At her level, she didn't need to pay too much attention to it. However, Inhumans were indeed quite novel, and they were different from Aroshia.

It was not a bad thing for Black Star to recruit them. Ames thought to herself.

She couldn't see anything for a while. Ames looked around and flew past the crowd to the stronghold that Black Star had told her about.

The players in the square had already taken countless photos from all angles. It was a pity that they could not see the bottom of her skirt. Otherwise, the fans of the Dragon Emperor would have been shouting that they could die without regrets.

After she left, the players excitedly whispered to each other.

"I didn't expect to see the Dragon Emperor in person. She's so beautiful."

"I think I'm in love."

"What a bunch of losers! Just a beautiful woman and you've all lost your morals! No principles and no bottom line! Can't you learn from me? I'll always like Fu Ding! "

Other than the fans who took fancy screenshots, there were also the hardcore players who guessed the reason for Ames' appearance.

"That's weird. Ames should be a very high-ranking person. Why would she come to Blue Star? I feel like we shouldn't have come into contact with her at this stage."

"Is there even a need to guess? It's written on the Wayne Cards. Go back and copy the effect of the Black Star card a hundred times."

"As expected of the Black Star Network. So what if she's the boss? She can still pull him in whenever she wants."

The players all knew that the Black Star Mercenary carried the name of Floating Dragon's armed forces. They had a deep background and strong backing. The Black Star Mercenary was far ahead of the rest, and Godora's taillights could not even be seen.

Han Xiao's faction shared the attraction of Floating Dragon to a certain extent. The main reason was because of Ames' charisma. Joining the Black Star Mercenary was equivalent to getting close to Ames. This logic had always attracted many hardcore players to join the mercenary group.

"However, why did Black Star call the Dragon Emperor over? Is it because of the Mutation Disaster?"

"It can't be. The Mutation Disaster wouldn't require Ames to take action, right?"

The players discussed endlessly, and the discussion platform also changed to the forums.

Many of the players had high expectations for the Main Storyline of the Mutation Disaster and felt that there would be some sort of heaven-shaking twist. These guesses were not baseless, and according to the commotion caused by Ames every time she appeared, she was definitely someone who could create huge news.

When Ames was mentioned, it was impossible to avoid mentioning Han Xiao, which allowed him to ride on a wave of popularity. The Planet Aquamarine players felt very proud of the fact that Han Xiao had dragged Ames over, and they looked down on the players from the other novice planets. They had a strange sense of superiority as if they were saying, "My novice village might explode, can you guys do it?"

Nagojin acted swiftly and personally escorted the Mutation Source to Godora's mother planet. Han Xiao completed the negotiations and headed straight to the mercenary group's stronghold in the Sanctuary with a relaxed expression. Along the way, he thought about the future developments.

No matter how fast Godora's research was, it would still require time. This was not a big problem, and Han Xiao's patience had already reached a level where he would not be in a hurry even if the fish were anxious.

I only need to wait. Godora will take about a month to research the antidote, and Dark-star can still be rampant for a period of time. However, with so little time, their plans will not be able to cause any waves.

After handing over the Mutation Source, before Godora could research the antidote, he would be completely free. There was no need to worry about Blue Star's safety. Dark-star's intelligence network would definitely discover Ames. If they dared to create trouble in such a situation, they would definitely be stubborn.

What should I do in this month? I don't need to worry about the disaster relief, and the recruitment of players is also on track. In a month, there will not be any huge changes to the Mutation Disaster. The benefits of the skills that I impart will gradually decrease, and the players will also be leveling up. There will not be as much profit as before.

Han Xiao was a little unwilling. Could it be that even he had to join the group of salted fish playing cards?

No, definitely not! Even if he was bored to death and jumped down from here, he would definitely not play cards!

It seemed like he could only go into seclusion to build machinery.

"I earned 3,000,000 Enas from Godora, and together with the remaining 1,100,000 Enas, my funds are now back at 4,000,000 Enas. Hmm, since I have money now, I can use it to buy some new class knowledge and new combat equipment."

Han Xiao pondered for a moment before his eyes suddenly lit up.

Right, he still had to build a sub-base in Blue Star to officially connect with the galaxy and continuously send in new players. Now, he could put that on the agenda.

He did not even need to think about the location, and he could just directly transform it into a sanctuary. Bennett would definitely not have any objections.

The materials were all ready-made, and some of the important equipment could be purchased from the galactic merchants. As for the construction work, he had millions of ready-made men. Free labor was the real benefit, and he could even issue missions to enrich the players' spare time. Even the strongest leek needed to be constantly watered and fertilized.

Using the galactic configuration of Base No.1, even the nuclear bombs of the Six Nations would not be able to penetrate the protective shield of the base.

This way, I'll have something to do during this period.

After making up his mind, Han Xiao returned to the stronghold hall. Just as he was about to instruct Herlous on this matter, he realized that Ames was already there. Herlous and the other officers were standing at the side, looking very cautious. Even further away, there were many players looking over with excitement.

Ever since the players showed that they were strong enough to wipe out the beast horde, the officers returned to the sanctuary to continue slacking off. Under their lead, the stronghold hall became a chess room. When the casual players had nothing to do, they would come here to play cards.

"You're here." Herlous hurriedly greeted Han Xiao. In front of Ames, he felt immense pressure, and he had to consider every word carefully, afraid of offending the Dragon Emperor.

Han Xiao walked over, smiled at Ames, and said, "You've already met the Inhumans?"

"You're right. They're very interesting." Ames looked at Han Xiao and retracted her aura, no longer testing Han Xiao's subordinates. The pressure on the mercenary officers was instantly lifted, and they heaved a sigh of relief.

"I'll get someone to arrange a room for you. I have nothing to do anyway, so I have plenty of time to observe."

Ames smiled and said, "Okay."

Since she was already there, she naturally would not leave after taking a look at the players. She could also visit Black Star's hometown.

"By the way, I used Floating Dragon's name to negotiate with Godora just now. They're very grateful to you."

"Hmm."

"Godora's people should take the initiative to meet you later. I'll make the arrangements."

"Okay, do as you deem fit."

"You seem to care about the abilities of Hella and Aurora. I'll introduce them to you later."

"Okay."

The two of them looked at each other and smiled.

Ames had a casual personality and was not the type to put on airs. Since Han Xiao had arranged everything, she accepted it. After interacting with him for the past few days, she was used to using this gentle tone to communicate with Han Xiao.

Furthermore, she did not hate Han Xiao.

However, in the eyes of the others, they misunderstood it and were stunned.

The Dragon Emperor had always been mysterious. These people did not understand Ames' personality like Han Xiao did, and most of them had not even seen this boss of theirs before. In their minds, the Dragon Emperor should be an extremely powerful person, the type that could make one's knees go weak with just one look. There was no way she would be so easy to talk to. Furthermore, she had clearly given them a huge amount of pressure earlier, and it was only when Han Xiao appeared that the pressure Ames exerted disappeared.

As for Herlous, who had seen the Dragon Emperor a few times before, he realized that Ames' attitude toward Han Xiao was completely different from before. She was more than ten times gentler.

She behaved obediently, and her tone was so gentle. She did not seem like the high and mighty Dragon Emperor at all. When she was talking to the officers earlier, she did not use such a tone. Only a blind person would not be able to tell the difference.

Could it be that these two people …

Have that kind of relationship?

Herlous opened his eyes wide and looked at Han Xiao's back in disbelief.

The three Volga brothers opened their mouths wide with a look of disbelief.

Fu Ding subconsciously touched his face.

At this moment, it was as if a storm was brewing in the hearts of the officers.

Harmon felt that the atmosphere was weird. He looked left and right and could not figure out what was going on.

The jaws of the players nearby almost dropped to the ground.

In the crowd, Pork Bun, who was following and reporting, saw this scene. His eyes lit up, and a lightbulb lit up in his head!

No wonder Black Star could call Ames over so casually. This was the real reason!

The Wayne Card did not lie to me!

Pork Bun's breathing became heavy, and he instantly thought of a few hundred thousand words of plot twists and turns.

This … this is seducing his boss, getting both the person and the money!

Even someone of Ames' level was taken in by him. Black Star's charm was simply terrifying!

"Big news!" Pork Bun frantically backed up the recording.

An hour ago …

Somewhere in Blue Star, at the base of the Dark-star undercover team …

"Eh, Black Star left for more than half a month and came back today. I wonder what he went to do."

A surveillance officer opened the satellite surveillance footage and casually glanced at it. Suddenly, he felt as if his head had been hit by a hammer, and he trembled from head to toe.

He rubbed his eyes and looked at the footage over ten times. Only after staring so hard that his eyes almost popped out did he confirm that his eyes were not playing tricks on him. His lips trembled.

What did I just see? Dragon Emperor Ames?

That monster that destroyed a Dark-star mothership with one hit!

"Quick, quick, quick, report to the higher-ups! Urgent news! "
